description_text: Este é um  Banco de Talentos,  destinado ao cadastro de  Pessoas com Deficiência para todas as unidades da John Deere no Brasil . Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência, fique à vontade para se candidatar a qualquer outra posição disponível em nosso site. Caso não encontre nenhuma vaga que seja de seu interesse, cadastre-se aqui, e avaliaremos suas informações para futuras oportunidades que possam surgir. Seja você, seja John Deere. Faça parte do nosso time! Áreas para as quais recrutamos no Brasil Administração Geral; Contábil; Controladoria; Engenharia; Financeiro; Jurídico; Logística; Marketing; Operações; Order Fulfillment; Qualidade; Recursos Humanos; Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente; Suporte ao produto; Suprimentos; Tecnologia da informação. Unidades John Deere Brasil: São Paulo Campinas Indaiatuba Goiás Catalão Rio Grande do Sul Horizontina Montenegro Quem não é uma pessoa com deficiência, pode se inscrever? Este banco de talentos é destinado a todas as pessoas com deficiência, caso não faça parte desse grupo, acesse nossas oportunidades na  página de carreiras . (Por favor, anexe o seu laudo) Por que a John Deere está fazendo um banco de talentos para pessoas com deficiências? Reconhecemos e valorizamos a pluralidade dos nossos times. Por isso, criamos condições para a equidade de oportunidades através de políticas, práticas e atitudes que promovam uma cultura de respeito e o desenvolvimento de talentos. O Que Você Receberá Na John Deere, você conseguirá desenvolver uma carreira que levará você aonde quer chegar. Além de produzirmos máquinas conectadas e inteligentes, com a mais alta qualidade, criamos soluções e serviços que garantam que nossos clientes possam gerir seus negócios de forma sustentável e produtiva. Com conexões tecnológicas, sociais e humanas, você terá liberdade de explorar novos projetos e pensar de forma inovadora.

Título: UX Designer PL - Indaiatuba/SP (Duas vagas) - 118989 This role centers on optimizing customer, dealer, and internal user interfaces for better usability and efficiency. Bachelor´s degree in IT Engineering, Marketing, Designer UX/UI or related fields in IT? Advanced English (broad vocabulary, impeccable grammar, ability to lead meetings, negotiate and deliver training); Experience in UX/UI design, including work on digital products or applications; Proficiency in Figma for design and rapid prototyping; Solid foundation in user‑centered design, usability, and interaction design principles; Ability to translate customer needs and business requirements into clear, effective design solutions; Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions to technical and non‑technical stakeholders. Experience working in agile product teams; Ability to clearly explain design rationale and influence decisions; This powerful purpose is our promise to humankind that we will dream, design, and deliver breakthrough products that sustain our world for generations to come. The world is counting on us to feed billions of people and build vital infrastructures in villages, towns and megacities. And we live up to the legacy our founder forged in a one-room blacksmith's shop nearly two centuries ago by creating a culture that brings out the best in all of us. A culture where great ideas thrive because every voice is heard. Main Responsabilities Design, schedule, build, and deliver new and enhanced, moderately complex portals and websites to achieve the agreed plan in terms of quality, cost, and timing, and create an engaging website; Develop website maps, application models, and image or page templates to meet user needs, industry standards, and/or project goals; Support digital channel management by analyzing best practices through competitive benchmarking, customer insights, A/B testing, feedback from cross-functional partners, and site feature/functionality enhancement; Research and interpret data, trends, and benchmarks relevant to digital products/services design; Support the implementation of differentiating customer experience initiatives, tools, and processes, including customer experience testing; Identify shortcomings in existing processes, systems, and procedures, and use established change management programs to address them; Collate and analyze data using preset tools, methods, and formats. Involves working independently; Contribute to the understanding of user segments, trends, needs, and expectations by reporting and providing feedback on client interactions.

Working within a global Agile environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve moderately complex technical challenges, participate in code reviews, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our software ecosystem and enterprise platforms. Develop and enhance existing applications and contribute to the development of new ones by analyzing requirements and identifying opportunities for improvement; Design, implement, and maintain software integrations, with a strong focus on consuming and exposing RESTful APIs; Develop backend services using Node.js and/or Python; Contribute to frontend development using JavaScript and React; Monitor, identify, and resolve moderately complex software defects to ensure stable and reliable applications; Work with cloud‑based infrastructure, preferably AWS, to support scalable and secure solutions; Collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Engineering Leadership in a global, distributed team; Follow industry‑standard agile development practices for design, implementation, and documentation; Support knowledge sharing through code reviews, pair programming, and collaborative problem-solving; Work within established project and development plans to achieve defined goals and priorities. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent fields; Advanced English (broad vocabulary, strong grammar, able to lead meetings, argue, negotiate, and conduct training sessions); Hands-on experience with Node.js or Python; Experience with React or similar modern frontend frameworks; Solid experience working with REST APIs and system integrations; Understanding of software engineering fundamentals: design, testing, debugging, and maintainability; Ability to solve well-defined problems with moderate complexity and limited supervision; Availability to work in a hybrid model, 3 times a week, in Indaiatuba/SP. Experience with SAP SuccessFactors, especially Talent Management modules; Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and infrastructure as code;
